title: myIO smart home controller
description: matterbridge-myio by myIO Smart Home - exposes the outputs, shutters, thermostats and sensors of myIO controllers to Matter

controllers.title: Controllers
controllers.description: The myIO controllers to bridge. Only the elements visible to the given user are exposed, so a dedicated user with limited permissions is the easiest way to choose what appears in Matter.

name.title: Name
name.description: A label for the logs (e.g. Ground floor)

host.title: Address
host.description: IP address or host name of the controller (e.g. 192.168.1.170)

pollInterval.title: Poll interval (ms)
pollInterval.description: How often the state is read from the controller. A Due (3.x firmware) is never polled faster than every 2000 ms.

rediscoverInterval.title: Rediscover interval (s)
rediscoverInterval.description: How often the names and the list of elements are read again. A new, renamed or removed element appears in Matter after at most this time.

exposeUnnamed.title: Expose unnamed outputs
exposeUnnamed.description: By default only the outputs that have a name on the controller are exposed.

relayType.title: Relays appear as
relayType.description: Device type of the on/off outputs whose name has no light keyword.

lightKeywords.title: Light keywords
lightKeywords.description: An on/off output whose name contains one of these words appears as a light (case and accents are ignored).

exposeShutters.title: Shutters
exposeShutters.description: Protection pairs (UP / DOWN outputs) appear as window coverings instead of two switches.

shutterTravelTime.title: Shutter travel time (s)
shutterTravelTime.description: Time of a full run from open to closed. The position shown in Matter is estimated from it.

shutterTravelTimes.title: Travel time per shutter
shutterTravelTimes.description: Shutters whose full run takes a different time.

name.title: Shutter name
name.description: The name as it appears in Matter

exposeThermostats.title: Thermostats
exposeThermostats.description: Outputs switched by a temperature sensor appear as thermostats (target = the middle of the ON / OFF thresholds).

exposeRgb.title: RGB lights
exposeRgb.description: Groups named RGB... with R / G / B dimmer channels appear as one colour light.

exposeSensors.title: Sensors
exposeSensors.description: Temperature and humidity sensors, and the universal sensors of type temperature, humidity, dew point, illuminance and pressure.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If the list is empty, all the devices will be exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed. If the list is empty, no devices will be excluded.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Log every command sent to the controller and every attribute update.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown (development only)
